description: Use this when someone organizing a conference, trade show or event wants companies that might sponsor or exhibit at it. Takes their event (a name or website, if it is in the database) and/or a topic and a place. Returns the companies listed at the most similar conferences, with how many of those conferences each was at, how many as a sponsor or partner, and a few of the events, plus the conferences compared. Company-level only.

event.description: The organizer's own conference or one like it: a name such as "Money20/20" or a website such as money2020.com.

limit.description: Companies to return, default 25, at most 50.

location.description: A city, country or region, such as Chicago, Germany or Europe. Leave out for anywhere.

topic.description: Industry or subject of the event, such as fintech, healthcare, AI or retail. Leave out to use the named event's industry.

name: find_sponsors_for_event
title: Find sponsors for an event
